SELECT s.store_id >= 900 AS pseudo, s.store_id IN (900,999) AS x, f.channel_code, f.vat_rate, f.staff_purchase_flag, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dist_lines, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(f.gross_amount) gross, sum(f.gross_amount-f.net_amount) vat, sum(f.net_amount*f.vat_rate) calc_vat, min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date)

calls.statement:
WITH p AS (SELECT f.*, s.store_id, s.store_name FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22')
SELECT 'pseudo_st' chk, store_id::VARCHAR k, count(*) n, sum(gross_amount-net_amount) v FROM p WHERE store_id>=900 AND channel_code='ST' GROUP BY ALL
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_receipt_line', 'x', count(*), 0 FROM (SELECT receipt_id,line_no FROM p GROUP BY ALL HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_all_but_id', 'x', count(*), 0 FROM (SELECT receipt_id,line_no,product_key,quantity,net_amount FROM p GROUP BY ALL HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'gross_ne_net_x_rate', 'x', count(*), sum(gross_amount-net_amount) FROM p WHERE abs(gross_amount-net_amount*(1+vat_rate))>0.02
UNION ALL SELECT 'local_date_mismatch', 'x', count(*), sum(gross_amount-net_amount) FROM p WHERE CAST((sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Helsinki' AS DATE) <> sale_date
UNION ALL SELECT 'etl_loaded', CAST(CAST(etl_loaded_at AS DATE) AS VARCHAR), count(*), sum(gross_amount-net_amount) FROM p GROUP BY ALL
UNION ALL SELECT 'store_valid_mismatch','x',count(*),0 FROM p JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=p.store_key WHERE p.sale_date NOT BETWEEN s.valid_from AND s.valid_to
UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_or_zero', 'x', count(*), sum(gross_amount-net_amount) FROM p WHERE net_amount<=0 OR quantity<=0

SELECT 'fact_total' k, count(*) n, sum(gross_amount-net_amount) v FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'
UNION ALL SELECT 'fact_unmatched_store', count(*), sum(gross_amount-net_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_store s WHERE s.store_key=f.store_key)
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_in_period', count(*), sum(gross_amount-net_amount) FROM stg_sales_line_load WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_not_in_fact', count(*), sum(gross_amount-net_amount) FROM stg_sales_line_load g WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sales_line_id=g.sales_line_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns_store_vat', count(*), sum(refund_gross-refund_net) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id<900
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns_all_vat', count(*), sum(refund_gross-refund_net) FROM fact_return_line r WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'
UNION ALL SELECT 'days_covered', count(DISTINCT sale_date), 0 FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'
UNION ALL SELECT 'stores_covered', count(DISTINCT s.store_id), 0 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND channel_code='ST' AND store_id<900

calls.statement:
SELECT c.fiscal_year, c.fiscal_period, round(f.vat_rate*100, 1) AS vat_rate_pct, sum(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat_charged_eur
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar c ON c.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND c.fiscal_period = 5
WHERE f.channel_code = 'ST' AND s.store_id < 900
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN c.period_start_date AND c.period_end_date
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY vat_rate_pct

SELECT f.sale_date, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores, count(*) n
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key)
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND f.channel_code='ST' AND s.store_id<900
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1
